subject: Scheduling: demo orchestration across sites & security windows
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tom Liao <tom.liao@novasystems.com>
Cc: Samira Nazir <samira.nazir@novasystems.com>
Date: Thu, 8 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + demo windows after your self-serve signup

Hi Tom / Samira,

Thanks for signing up and trying Redwood — glad you kicked the tires. I want to line up a short coordinated demo so we can include an AE (me), an SE (Soohin), and any IT or security stakeholders you want on the call. That'll help us cover latency/cost controls and the private deployment checklist up front.

Attached is a one-pager with a suggested agenda. I also attached a quick ICS with a few proposed windows (proposed_slots.ics). To make scheduling less painful, here are three 60-min options I can host (in your local time zone, which I assume is CEST):

- Tue May 13, 10:00–11:00 CEST (01:00–02:00 PDT)
- Wed May 14, 15:00–16:00 CEST (06:00–07:00 PDT)
- Thu May 15, 08:30–09:30 CEST (23:30–00:30 PDT previous day)

If those don't work, tell me the windows that do and whether IT/security need a separate pre-call to review network/firewall requirements.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Soojin (SE) here so she can confirm tech availability.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: redwood-demo-brief.pdf, proposed_slots.ics
From: Tom Liao <tom.liao@novasystems.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Nazir <samira.nazir@novasystems.com>, IT Security <security@novasystems.com>
Date: Thu, 8 May 2025 18:03:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo windows after your self-serve signup

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick follow-up — Samira and I will join. A few notes from our side:

- We prefer a 45-minute focused session for the product + a short 15-minute security Q&A.
- Our primary IT/security folks (security@novasystems.com) are available only between 14:00–16:30 CEST most days next week.
- We’d like the SE to cover network requirements (firewall ports, egress rules) early in the call.

Of your three options the Wed May 14, 15:00–15:45 CEST slot looks best. Can Soojin join at 15:00 CEST? If not, we can move to Thu May 15 at 08:30 CEST but that’s less preferred.

Also, please send over the IT checklist ahead of time so our security team can triage.

—Tom
Tom Liao
Head of Platform Engineering, Nova Systems
Tom.Liao@novasystems.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tom Liao <tom.liao@novasystems.com>, Samira Nazir <samira.nazir@novasystems.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, IT Security <security@novasystems.com>
Date: Thu, 8 May 2025 19:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo windows after your self-serve signup

Thanks Tom — that works.

Soojin — can you confirm you can do Wed May 14 at 15:00 CEST (06:00 PDT)? I know that’s early on our side; if that’s a hard no, propose your earliest alternative and we’ll see if the customer can move.

Marissa — flag for awareness: this will be our first cross-team demo with an infra-heavy customer; I expect potential follow-ups on dedicated/private deployment. I’ve attached the demo brief and an IT checklist (it-checklist.docx) so security can pre-read.

I’ll draft a calendar invite once everyone confirms and include a 15-minute security segment at the end.

Karthik

Cc: Samira Nazir <samira.nazir@novasystems.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 May 2025 20:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo windows after your self-serve signup

Morning all — can confirm I can join Wed May 14 at 15:00 CEST (06:00 PDT). I’ll aim to cover network/firewall and a short slide on quantization/latency tradeoffs early in the demo.

Tom/Samira — attaching the IT checklist I mentioned (it-checklist.docx). It lists inbound/outbound ports, required TLS versions, and a short section on allowed egress endpoints. If you can have your security team review the checklist pre-call it will save time. Also, if there are strict maintenance windows on your side please flag them — we’ll avoid those.

I can hop on a 15-min pre-call 30 minutes before the demo to review any redlines if security wants that.

Cheers,
Soojin (SE)
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

All right — Wed May 14 15:00–15:45 CEST confirmed. Security will join for the final 15 minutes (security@novasystems.com).

Please send a calendar invite (we operate in CEST). I’m attaching our internal meeting placeholder (calendar.ics) — if you can send the invite with both CEST and PDT times that helps avoid confusion.

See you then — Tom
